shared.title: How bridges stand up
shared.description: Tension, compression and resonance: a walk through the forces in a bridge, from the Roman arch to the Tacoma Narrows collapse of 1940.

orders.excerpt: the romans did not have steel so every bridge they built is an arch and an arch only ever pushes
in november nineteen forty the tacoma narrows bridge began to twist in a wind of about forty miles an hour and an hour later it fell
